rule: Unknown things get invented words from pools: a flavour word per potion, ring or similar kind, drawn from materials; a pool word per unknown scroll. Backstory is a chain of short phrase charts per race (3 to 8 steps), each step a cumulative roll over phrase lines. Vaults carry a type word and a depth band. Pits are room templates with a monster-family filter, allocation and rarity. The endgame is a fixed pair of named foes at levels 99 and 100. Shops are fixed identifiers with a named owner.
keep: Unknown names drawn from a pool of invented words, so unknown potions, rings and scrolls each feel like a mystery.
Backstory as a short race-specific chain of phrases with cumulative rolls.
Vault type word plus depth band as a one-glance danger label.
Pit as a room template: family filter, allocation, rarity, optional spell limits.
Two fixed named endgame foes rather than a generated ladder.
Shops as fixed identifiers with a named owner.

look_test: Three cards only, published to the preview folder with no release rows: (1) an unknown item row, a potion with a flavour word, a scroll with a pool word, a ring with a material word; (2) a zone card with a type word, a depth band, one short line and a shop line; (3) a three-step backstory for one Pit character in our own phrases. Dom judges on his phone whether an unknown name feels like a mystery worth solving, whether one card reads as a place, and whether a short chain feels like a life.
